gasContract.terms: Offer only available in areas where AGL operates.To be eligible for this plan, you must hold gas and/or electricity accounts on AGL’s Business Multi-Property plan for at least two small business supply addresses under the same ABN or ACN; otherwise, AGL may terminate your market contract and move you to a standard retail contract. For further information about the terms and conditions applicable to this energy offer, please contact AGL on 131 245 or visit agl.com.au.
gasContract.variation: This plan also includes variable rates, retail fees and charges, which can change at any time with notice to you. If we vary your rates, we will give you at least 5 business days prior notice of the variation. Other charges may be varied with notice

incentives.eligibility: For new & moving AGL customers who stay with AGL at the same address for 90 days from start of the plan. Credit will appear on next bill after 90 days. Non-transferable. Accounts may be excluded from receiving more than one credit per fuel in 12 months.

eligibility.information: This offer applies to customers with an applicable network tariff.

gasContract.onExpiryDescription: Your market contract is ongoing. From time to time, AGL reviews its offers and this offer will be reviewed with consideration to AGL’s generally available market offers
